explication: Cloud-init provisions a cloud or bare-metal instance from image, cloud metadata, and optional user/vendor data. At boot, its command entry point selects a datasource, runs staged initialization, parses configuration, and dispatches modules that configure networking, storage, packages, accounts, SSH, and commands through distro-specific abstractions. Results are persisted as instance data and reported. The tree supports many providers and distributions; only representative datasource and platform implementations were sampled, so provider-specific wiring is shown at subsystem level.
